Name: Crafting Overhaul
Author: DZK312
Description:
I am open to feedback for further potential changes or balancing.
I [i]might[/i] also consider adding adjustments for structure costs (ie obelisks) and/or cooking in later updates, but am undecided on that, especially with cooking.

For a list of all changes, refer to this google sheet:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1328-2d7HXarWx7aVEOppUVqZ9nRRzepK4isgWG6OxnA/edit?usp=sharing

Downloads.Description: Overhauls a majority of the crafting recipes in the game to be more diverse, inclusive, balanced, and fun! Additionally adjusts a few crafted items' prices for balance.
